note: RFC §9.2 amendment (PE8-DEADLINE-INTEGRITY): the HARNESS controller may read time.monotonic() ONLY as a DISPATCHED/COMPLETED window-stamp emit body. A clock read in the controller under any other marker (here READY) is still flagged, so the exception stays scoped to the window timebase and never becomes a blanket controller pass.
source:
HARNESS = r'''
import json, time
def emit(tag, body=""):
    pass
emit("READY", repr(time.monotonic()))
'''
